items.name: Padded
items.description: Quilted layers of cloth and batting. Imposes disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

items.name: Leather
items.description: Breastplate and shoulder protectors made of leather stiffened by boiling in oil.

items.name: Studded leather
items.description: Tough but flexible leather reinforced with close-set rivets or spikes.

items.name: Hide
items.description: Crude armor consisting of thick furs and pelts.

items.name: Chain shirt
items.description: Interlocking metal rings worn between layers of clothing or leather; offers modest protection and muffles ring noise.

items.name: Scale mail
items.description: Coat and leggings of leather covered with overlapping metal scales. Imposes disadvantage on Stealth checks.

items.name: Breastplate
items.description: Fitted metal chest piece worn with supple leather; leaves arms and legs relatively unprotected without hindering Stealth.

items.name: Half plate
items.description: Shaped metal plates covering most of the body. Imposes disadvantage on Stealth checks.

items.name: Ring mail
items.description: Leather armor with heavy rings sewn into it. Imposes disadvantage on Stealth checks.

items.name: Chain mail
items.description: Interlocking metal rings with quilted fabric underneath. Requires Strength 13 (otherwise -10 ft. speed); disadvantage on Stealth.

items.name: Splint
items.description: Narrow vertical strips of metal riveted to a leather backing. Requires Strength 15; disadvantage on Stealth.

items.name: Plate
items.description: Shaped, interlocking metal plates covering the entire body. Requires Strength 15; disadvantage on Stealth.

items.name: Shield
items.description: Carried in one hand; grants +2 AC. You can benefit from only one shield at a time.
